_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Envoy Part II#000.src: Use Maxie's house key to enter Maxie's house
The Envoy Part II#000.dst: 用 Maxie 的家門鑰匙進入 Maxie 的家

The Envoy Part II#003.src: Talk to Maxie on the first floor.
The Envoy Part II#003.dst: 在一樓與 Maxie 對話。

The Envoy Part II#004.src: Mo'in. I've been researching everything I can about the factory.
The Envoy Part II#004.dst: Mo'in。關於那座工廠，我能查的都查了。
The Envoy Part II#004.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#005.src: To get in we need two keys. One from the Avos and one from Corkians.
The Envoy Part II#005.dst: 要進去得有兩把鑰匙。一把在 Avos 手上，一把在 Corkians 手上。
The Envoy Part II#005.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#006.src: The idea was that both species had equal roles in the factories operantions.
The Envoy Part II#006.dst: 當初的用意，是讓兩個種族在工廠的運作上地位平等。
The Envoy Part II#006.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#007.src: We need those keys in get in and shut down the factory once more.
The Envoy Part II#007.dst: 我們得拿到那兩把鑰匙才進得去，才能再一次把工廠關掉。
The Envoy Part II#007.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#008.src: The corkians won't give up their key very easily, so we should start with the Avos.
The Envoy Part II#008.dst: Corkians 不會輕易交出他們那把，所以我們先從 Avos 下手。
The Envoy Part II#008.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#009.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief. However, because of tensions the border is closed.
The Envoy Part II#009.dst: 最好的辦法是去問族長。可是因為關係緊張，邊界已經封閉了。
The Envoy Part II#009.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#010.src: Fortunately there is something that can help us in a village north-west of here. Let's meet there.
The Envoy Part II#010.dst: 幸好西北邊有座村子，那裡有樣東西幫得上忙。我們在那裡碰面。
The Envoy Part II#010.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#012.src: I knew it! There was something here we could use.
The Envoy Part II#012.dst: 我就知道！這裡果然有能用的東西。
The Envoy Part II#012.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#013.src: I'll have to use electromagic to make it launch, so you will have to go alone.
The Envoy Part II#013.dst: 我得用 electromagic 才能把它發射出去，所以你得一個人去。
The Envoy Part II#013.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#014.src: Find the Avos chief. Ask for the factory key.
The Envoy Part II#014.dst: 找到 Avos 的族長，向他要工廠的鑰匙。
The Envoy Part II#014.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#016.src: Press the button when you're ready.
The Envoy Part II#016.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#019.src: Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens. Avos Chief is at -{~}, -{~}
The Envoy Part II#019.dst: 向 Avos 的居民打聽，找出 Avos 族長的位置。族長在 -{~1}, -{~2}

The Envoy Part II#020.src: Hmm no gears or goggles.. You are no Corkian Human.
The Envoy Part II#020.dst: 唔，沒有齒輪，也沒有護目鏡……你不是 Corkus 的人類。
The Envoy Part II#020.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#021.src: The chief said your people are welcome here.
The Envoy Part II#021.dst: 族長說過，你的同族在這裡是受歡迎的。
The Envoy Part II#021.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#022.src: You must be here to see him.
The Envoy Part II#022.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#023.dst: 順著這道階梯上去就是了。
The Envoy Part II#023.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#024.src: Mo'in, soldier. I have been expecting you.
The Envoy Part II#024.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#025.src: You can't catapult yourself into a village full of bird people and not get noticed.
The Envoy Part II#025.dst: 你把自己用投石機扔進一座滿是鳥人的村子，怎麼可能沒人注意到。
The Envoy Part II#025.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#026.src: We know what you are here for, however. The Avos factory key.
The Envoy Part II#026.dst: 不過我們知道你來的目的：Avos 那把工廠鑰匙。
The Envoy Part II#026.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#027.src: We saw your battle with “Mech X” at the docks from above. I believe we can trust you.
The Envoy Part II#027.dst: 你在碼頭跟「Mech X」那一戰，我們在空中看得清清楚楚。我相信你是可信的。
The Envoy Part II#027.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#028.src: The key you seek is hidden deep within our most protected temple.
The Envoy Part II#028.dst: 你要找的鑰匙，藏在我們守衛最森嚴的神殿深處。
The Envoy Part II#028.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#029.src: Follow the road north of here to reach the temple. Speak to the grandmaster and she will allow you entry.
The Envoy Part II#029.dst: 沿著北邊那條路走就會到神殿。去跟大宗師說一聲，她會放你進去。
The Envoy Part II#029.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#030.src: Talk to the chief's friend at

The Envoy Part II#031.src: Eh, It's the warrior. I have my orders, but still say this is a bad idea.
The Envoy Part II#031.dst: 哼，是那個戰士啊。我是奉命行事，但我還是要說，這主意很糟。
The Envoy Part II#031.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#032.src: We hid this key for the purpose that it would never be used again.
The Envoy Part II#032.dst: 我們把這把鑰匙藏起來，就是為了讓它永遠不再被使用。
The Envoy Part II#032.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#033.src: The creatures we summoned down there are hostile to all. Even Avos.
The Envoy Part II#033.dst: 我們召到下面去的那些東西對誰都懷有敵意。連 Avos 也不例外。
The Envoy Part II#033.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#034.src: I can't say I have high hopes for you.
The Envoy Part II#034.dst: 我對你可沒抱多大期望。
The Envoy Part II#034.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#035.src: Meet me round the back of my house and I shall show you the way.
The Envoy Part II#035.dst: 到我屋子後面來找我，我會帶你走那條路。
The Envoy Part II#035.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#036.src: Meet the grandmaster behind her house and get over the gap and enter the temple.
The Envoy Part II#036.dst: 到大宗師屋後與她會合，越過斷崖進入神殿。

The Envoy Part II#037.src: I'll make the bridge for you.
The Envoy Part II#037.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#038.src: I don't see why we’re helping humans...
The Envoy Part II#038.dst: 我實在不懂我們為什麼要幫人類……
The Envoy Part II#038.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#039.src: You all act the same to me. Anyway, there you go.
The Envoy Part II#039.dst: 在我看來你們全都一個樣。算了，過去吧。
The Envoy Part II#039.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#040.src: Find the key inside the temple.

The Envoy Part II#041.src: You cannot have the key. Prepare for destruction.
The Envoy Part II#041.dst: 鑰匙不會給你。準備受死吧。
The Envoy Part II#041.speaker: Key Temple Dragon

The Envoy Part II#042.src: Return to Maxie in his house with the first key.
The Envoy Part II#042.dst: 帶著第一把鑰匙回到 Maxie 家找他。

The Envoy Part II#043.src: You're back, and you have the key!
The Envoy Part II#043.dst: 你回來了，而且拿到鑰匙了！
The Envoy Part II#043.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#044.src: Excellent. I will hold onto that for now. Let's focus on getting the Corkian's Key.
The Envoy Part II#044.dst: 太好了。這把先由我保管。接下來專心去拿 Corkians 那把。
The Envoy Part II#044.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#045.src: They keep it in a vault inside the castle. I honestly don't know how to get in there.
The Envoy Part II#045.dst: 他們把它鎖在城堡裡的金庫。老實說，我不知道要怎麼進去。
The Envoy Part II#045.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#046.src: I think first we should just go and scout out the vault itself and work it out.
The Envoy Part II#046.dst: 我想我們先去金庫那邊探探，再想辦法。
The Envoy Part II#046.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#047.src: I'll meet you there. It's in the castle and to the right. There's {~} guards there at all times, you can't miss it.
The Envoy Part II#047.dst: 我在那裡等你。金庫在城堡裡靠右邊，隨時都有 {~} 名守衛，不會找錯。
The Envoy Part II#047.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#050.src: Uh- No need to worry! We accidentally...
The Envoy Part II#050.dst: 呃——不用擔心！我們只是不小心……
The Envoy Part II#050.speaker: Bertil

The Envoy Part II#051.src: Blew a hole in the wall! Yep!
The Envoy Part II#051.dst: 在牆上炸了個洞！對，就是這樣！
The Envoy Part II#051.speaker: Reiva

The Envoy Part II#052.src: Stop. Maxie, was right. I'm sorry. Mech X pierced the vault like it was nothing and took the key.
The Envoy Part II#052.dst: 別說了。Maxie 是對的。我很抱歉。Mech X 像戳紙一樣穿透金庫，把鑰匙拿走了。
The Envoy Part II#052.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#053.src: The mechs were covered in farm produce for some reason and left a convenient trail. If you are serious about fighting the factory, follow it.
The Envoy Part II#053.dst: 那些 mech 不知為何沾滿了農作物，剛好留下一道好認的痕跡。你要是真心想跟工廠對抗，就順著它走。
The Envoy Part II#053.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#054.src: Look for the hidden mech base.
The Envoy Part II#054.dst: 尋找隱藏的 mech 基地。

The Envoy Part II#055.src: Psst! Over here, in the field!
The Envoy Part II#055.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#056.src: Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here.
The Envoy Part II#056.dst: Mo'in。看到上面那傢伙沒？我來到現在，他一寸都沒動過。
The Envoy Part II#056.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#057.src: I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#057.dst: 我看他根本不是農夫。跟我來。
The Envoy Part II#057.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#058.src: HELLO... I AM A... HUMAN... FARMER.
The Envoy Part II#058.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#059.src: DO YOU... HAVE... ANY BUSINESS... WITH ME?
The Envoy Part II#059.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#060.src: Nice try, mech! Not convincing enough for me!
The Envoy Part II#060.dst: 演得不錯嘛，mech！可惜騙不了我！
The Envoy Part II#060.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#061.src: REPORT... COVER HAS BEEN COMPROMISED... TWO UNAUTHORIZED INTRUDERS... OUTSIDE OF BASE.
The Envoy Part II#061.dst: 回報……偽裝已暴露……兩名未授權入侵者……位於基地外。
The Envoy Part II#061.speaker: S-63 Mech

The Envoy Part II#064.src: That model was a S-{~}, meaning it has warned the others. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#064.dst: 那台是 S-{~} 型，也就是說它已經通報其他同伴了。跟我來。
The Envoy Part II#064.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#065.dst: 你看，我們被鎖在外面了。
The Envoy Part II#065.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#066.src: Stand back, I'll open the door.
The Envoy Part II#066.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#067.src: I think we can safely assume this is the right place.
The Envoy Part II#067.dst: 我想我們可以放心斷定，就是這裡沒錯。
The Envoy Part II#067.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#068.src: You storm in and find what we need. I'll cover you from out here.
The Envoy Part II#068.dst: 你衝進去把我們要的東西找出來。我在外面掩護你。
The Envoy Part II#068.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#069.src: You need to find and destroy that new factory mech.
The Envoy Part II#069.dst: 你得找到那台工廠新造的 mech，把它毀掉。
The Envoy Part II#069.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#070.src: Retrieve the key from the base.

The Envoy Part II#071.dst: 偵測到入侵者。予以摧毀。
The Envoy Part II#071.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#072.src: Corkus has to suffer... They shut down the Factory, locked us up in there. Once we have both keys we can open it and you are NOT getting this one.
The Envoy Part II#072.dst: Corkus 必須付出代價……他們關閉了工廠，把我們鎖在裡面。等兩把鑰匙都到手，我們就能打開它——而這一把，你休想拿走。
The Envoy Part II#072.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#073.src: Find Maxie and give him the key.
The Envoy Part II#073.dst: 找到 Maxie，把鑰匙交給他。

The Envoy Part II#074.src: Mo'in. Did you get the key?
The Envoy Part II#074.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#075.src: Amazing. Now we need to meet at the factory. Now the real hard part begins.
The Envoy Part II#075.dst: 太厲害了。接下來我們在工廠會合。真正難的部分現在才開始。
The Envoy Part II#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#076.src: Follow the northwestern road and enter the factory from the west side. I will meet you there.
The Envoy Part II#076.dst: 沿著西北那條路走，從西側進入工廠。我在那裡等你。
The Envoy Part II#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#077.src: Find Maxie outside the factory at

The Envoy Part II#078.src: Mo'in. Are you sure you are ready?
The Envoy Part II#078.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#079.src: This won't be your average fight. The factory is cutting edge. Run by a being of pure electromagic.
The Envoy Part II#079.dst: 這不會是一般的戰鬥。那座工廠是最尖端的技術，由一個純粹以 electromagic 構成的存在在運轉。
The Envoy Part II#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#080.src: The smartest man on Corkus, Cerid spent years making a being smarter even than he is...
The Envoy Part II#080.dst: Corkus 最聰明的人 Cerid，花了好幾年造出一個比他自己更聰明的存在……
The Envoy Part II#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#081.src: Now it runs the factory with a twisted sense of morality. It's easy to see why it was shut down.
The Envoy Part II#081.dst: 如今它以一套扭曲的道德觀經營著那座工廠。工廠為什麼會被關閉，一看便知。
The Envoy Part II#081.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#082.src: Also.. I- I made you these boots using my magic. It turns out I am pretty good at making stuff.
The Envoy Part II#082.dst: 還有……我、我用我的魔法幫你做了這雙靴子。看來我在造東西這方面還挺行的。
The Envoy Part II#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#083.src: I just wanted to say thanks, too. I really feel like I made a difference fighting with you. When you are ready, just walk up to the factory doors.
The Envoy Part II#083.dst: 我也想跟你說聲謝謝。跟你並肩作戰，我真的覺得自己起了作用。準備好之後，直接走向工廠大門就行了。
The Envoy Part II#083.speaker: Maxie
